newsitem.title: USA: Cash flows into US junk bond mutual funds pick up.
newsitem.headline: Cash flows into US junk bond mutual funds pick up.

text.p: Net cash inflows into U.S. high-yield mutual funds surged to $470.4 million in the week ended April 23 compared to $100.8 million in the previous reported week, according to AMG Data Services.
The figures are from high-yield mutual funds that report on a weekly basis.
The past two week's net cash inflows follow four consecutive weeks of net cash outflows from U.S. junk bond mutual funds during late March and early April.
AMG, based in Arcata, Calif., is a U.S. mutual fund information company.
